engines.performance: Chatterbox Multilingual (Resemble AI, MIT) via chatterbox-tts; zero-shot timbre from a reference clip, emotion exaggeration, CFG pacing
engines.reference: Kokoro-82M (hexgrad, Apache-2.0) stock synthetic voicepacks; used only to create original reference timbres

policy: No real person's voice is cloned. Every timbre starts from a stock synthetic Kokoro voicepack, optionally pitch-shifted, then performed by Chatterbox.

kurozane.name: Shogun Kurozane
kurozane.brief: Centuries-old vampire sovereign. Deep, slow, courtly, enjoys his own cadence. Loses the sovereign resonance as he becomes mortal.

referenceText.en: I found this country exhausted by lords who burned a village to save it from the next lord. I made one hunger answerable to one hand, and the provinces learned to sleep.
referenceText.ja: 余が見たこの国は、次の領主から村を守るために村を焼く領主たちに疲れ果てていた。余は一つの飢えを、一つの手に従わせた。

mateus.name: Father Mateus Avelar
mateus.brief: Portuguese-born former Jesuit and court translator turned vampire priest. Weary baritone, scholarly precision; restraint until the confession breaks him.

referenceText.en: I translated fear into scripture for him. I do not escape that sentence by helping to write its last line. Hold the light steady, and let me read the cipher.
referenceText.ja: I translated fear into scripture for him. I do not escape that sentence by helping to write its last line. Hold the light steady, and let me read the cipher.

nikola.name: Nikola Dražanić
nikola.brief: Croatian-born vampire hunter of a self-mythologizing house. Confident, theatrical, one degree too pleased with himself; gravity appears without warning.

referenceText.en: The Covenant severs an immortal from office. It does not ask his nation, his blood, or his creed. Kindly step three paces to the left and admire the superior method.
referenceText.ja: The Covenant severs an immortal from office. It does not ask his nation, his blood, or his creed. Kindly step three paces to the left and admire the superior method.

ren.name: Ren Ishikawa
ren.brief: Young courier turned resistance lead. Plain, quick, unpretentious; quiet authority rather than speeches.

referenceText.en: Those are the choices your regime manufactured. They are not the only terms available now. Keep the names between us and the stairs.
referenceText.ja: それはお前の体制が作った選択肢だ。今あるのは、それだけじゃない。名簿は俺たちと階段のあいだに置いておけ。

miyo.name: Miyo Senda
miyo.brief: Weather scholar and Mateus's granddaughter. Clear, controlled, exact; anger arrives as precision.

referenceText.en: Cloud edge clears in four counts. Direct light lasts three before the bell shadow folds over it. I will call each interval aloud.
referenceText.ja: 雲の縁は四つ数えるうちに晴れます。直射の光は三つ。そのあと鐘の影が覆います。間隔は声に出して数えます。
